notes: Japanese GAAP (Annual Securities Report). paidOut exceeds revenue because FY2025 OCF was only 12,069: the company built inventory ahead of the Nintendo Switch 2 launch (increase in inventories 333,837), i.e. cash paid to suppliers in this year for goods sold later. Single-year paidOut is therefore inflated by a working-capital swing (it was 1,671,865 − 462,097 + 16,123 = 1,225,891 in FY2024 on far higher sales). Interest paid, interest and dividends received and income taxes paid are all inside OCF. Time-deposit and securities movements are in investing and are excluded from capex.
